task_definition.task_description: Check the current status of the crypto market and get the price of Bitcoin, then estimate the trading costs for that amount. After that, look up the stock info for Apple and use the quote profile to sell 25.5 shares of AAPL at that price, converting the proceeds to EUR. Finally, pull the latest business news and tell me the title of the first article.
